name: ClickGuard
description: Tick-based input buffer for Android 64-bit with quick controls in the pause menu.

enabled.name: Enable ClickGuard
enabled.description: Turn the tick-based input buffer on or off.

buffer-ticks.name: Buffer window (ticks)
buffer-ticks.description: Delay press and release events by this number of physics ticks. One tick is 1/240 second. Set to 0 for raw input. The pause-menu button cycles 2, 4, 8, 16 and OFF; Wave is capped at 8 ticks.
